The original `allocate` used plain floor division, which lost leftover cents (e.g. `[3,3,1]` of 100 summed to 98, not 100) and didn't handle negative totals/weights correctly. I rewrote it using the largest-remainder method: compute each share via Euclidean division (`div_euclid`/`rem_euclid`, which floors correctly even with negative numerators), then distribute the leftover cents to the partners with the biggest remainders, breaking ties by earliest index via a stable sort.
